prompt: A town with a craftsmen's district to the east.

card.name: Craftsmen's Town

site.text: An ordinary town on level ground, with a craftsmen's district on the east side.

style.text: Warm, practical medieval look with timber, stone and plank roofs.

purpose.text: A town for living and trade, with its crafting workshops grouped in an eastern district.

card.interpretation: A medium medieval market town on flat land, with a central square and civic buildings. The craftsmen's district sits on the east side: smithy, carpenter, mason, potter, weaver and tanner. Homes, a tavern and a chapel fill out the rest.
assumptions: Style is medieval since none was given.
Purpose is a market town, since crafts and trade fit a craftsmen's district.
No land line was given, so east is taken as true east of the founding stone.

program.notes: Civic heart of the town, facing the central square.
Stalls around the square selling goods from the craftsmen.
Near the square, with a common room and rooms upstairs.
Homes for townsfolk in the western and central parts.
Small chapel on slightly higher ground.
Forge in the eastern craftsmen's district, with an open yard and anvil.
Eastern district; timber stacks and a covered work area.
Eastern district; stone blocks and kilns outside.
